node.runtime: Rust 2024; distributed WASM in Node and browser; native CLI
node.notes: Separate git root; README describes a ground-up implementation. Checked-in pkg/ 0.4.0 distribution is pinned and individually hash-verified for Node/browser benchmarks. The advertised @frankenmermaid/core npm name returns 404. Distributed WASM predates current Rust source changes and differs from live-site JS/WASM bytes; no build-from-current-source or deployment parity is claimed. Public WASM exposes SVG, Canvas2D, parse/diagnostics, source-lens edits and deck manifests; native terminal rendering has no exported WASM terminal function. License includes the named restrictive rider and is not recorded as plain MIT. Published native v0.4.0 CLI was benchmarked separately, including startup; its release predates the measured WASM. Parser recovery returned SVG for the full browser inventory, with warnings/partial detections recorded separately from acceptance.

benchmarkEligibility.reason: Catalog declares svg, terminal, parse, diagnostics, source operations with adapter franken. Actual artifact/API availability, family coverage, correctness and timing are determined by execution, not role selection or configuration.
